spec.title: Repl. slot XMIN age (in transactions)
spec.description: Based on "pg_replication_slots.xmin". The oldest transaction that this slot needs the database to retain. VACUUM cannot remove tuples deleted by any later transaction.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $__interval),
  dbname,
  avg((data->>'xmin_age_tx')::int8)
FROM
  replication_slots
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname in ($dbname)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

spec.title: Active repl. slots
spec.description: Based on last 5m data. FYI - no thresholds defined

spec.query: select count("active") from (select last("active") as "active" FROM "replication_slots" WHERE "dbname" =~ /^$dbname$/ AND $timeFilter group by "dbname", "slot_name") WHERE "active" =  true
spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  0 as time,
  count(*) filter (where data->>'non_active_int' = '0')
FROM
  replication_slots
WHERE
  time in (select max(time) from replication_slots where $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) group by dbname)
  AND dbname in ($dbname)

spec.description: Data is available  only on connected replicas. No thresholds by default

spec.query: select count("last") from (SELECT last("state") FROM "replication" WHERE ("dbname" =~ /^$dbname$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), dbname, client_info fill(none)) where "last" = 'streaming'

spec.title: Replication flush lag
spec.description: Based on pg_stat_replication on primaries. Data is available  only on connected replicas!

spec.query: SELECT mean("write_lag_b") FROM "replication" WHERE ("dbname" =~ /^$dbname$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "dbname", "client_info", "application_name" fill(none)
spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(time, $__interval),
  dbname,
  avg((data->>'flush_lag_b')::int8)
FROM
  replication
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(time)
  AND dbname in ($dbname)
GROUP BY
  1, 2
ORDER BY
  1, 2

spec.description: Based on last 5m data.  > 1 ~ Error. Causes WAL accumulation on the master and possibly autovacuum inefficiencies

spec.query: select sum("last") from (select last("non_active_int") FROM "replication_slots" WHERE "dbname" =~ /^$dbname$/ AND $timeFilter group by "dbname", "slot_name")

FROM

WHERE
  time in (select max(time) from replication_slots where $__timeFilter(time) AND dbname in ($dbname) group by dbname)
  AND dbname in ($dbname)
